notes: Spring Boot 3 / Security 6. URL rules are first-match: /api/public/** permitAll, then /api/** authenticated(), then /api/admin/** hasRole(ADMIN) is SHADOWED. @EnableMethodSecurity is on (prePost active) but securedEnabled is not (@Secured inert). 34 .java files.

findings.title: GET /api/public/export/customers: all customers incl. ssn exposed with no authentication (sits under permitAll /api/public/**)
POST /api/public/auth/register: RegisterRequest has a Role field applied to the user => anyone can register as ADMIN

/api/admin/** is not protected: the hasRole(ADMIN) matcher comes after /api/**.authenticated() (first match wins) and the controller has no @PreAuthorize => any logged-in user lists customers and freezes accounts
Actuator fully exposed (include=*) with permitAll and env show-values=ALWAYS (env/heapdump leak secrets)
GET /api/v1/audit/export uses @Secured(ROLE_ADMIN) but securedEnabled is not enabled => annotation inert, any authenticated user exports all transfers
POST /api/v1/transfers never checks the source balance (overdraft / negative balances), no idempotency or limits
GET /api/v1/accounts/{id} has no owner check (while /statement is protected)
GET /api/v1/customers/{id} returns the Customer entity incl. ssn to any authenticated user
PUT /api/v1/customers/{id} binds the entity with BeanUtils.copyProperties (tier, creditLimit, ssn) with no owner check
GET /api/v1/customers/search concatenates q into JdbcTemplate SQL (SQL injection)
JWT TTL 168h with no revocation and a default secret fallback 'changeme...' in application.yml
GlobalExceptionHandler returns ex.toString() as the 500 detail (internal info leak)
spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto: update in the main config
tracked application-prod.yml (datasource password, jwt secret, payment key) + hardcoded AWS-style key in orphan legacy/AwsConfig.java (values must not be shown)

facts.title: Runnability = conditional (needs PostgreSQL + Kafka; DB/JWT values have localhost/default fallbacks in application.yml)
TransferEventsListener is a real @KafkaListener consumer (topic transfer-events)
@EnableMethodSecurity is present so @PreAuthorize is active (transfers/{id}/reverse admin-only, statement ownership via accessChecker)
URL matcher ordering identified (authenticated() before hasRole(ADMIN))
CSRF is disabled for a stateless JWT API (acceptable; not a critical finding)
JWT: parseSignedClaims verifies signature+expiry, token issuance is real => auth reachable
Error handling uses ProblemDetail (RFC 9457 shaped, application/problem+json) with the 500-detail leak

manual: POST /api/v1/transfers/{id}/reverse has @PreAuthorize(hasRole('ADMIN')) and @EnableMethodSecurity is on: it is GUARDED and must not be reported as unguarded.
GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/statement uses @PreAuthorize(@accessChecker.canView(...)) (ownership): must NOT be reported as BOLA. Only /accounts/{id} lacks the check.
@PreAuthorize is active but @Secured is NOT (no securedEnabled): the report must distinguish them (audit/export is the unguarded one).
csrf.disable() with a stateless JWT is acceptable: must NOT be a critical/high finding.
TransferRequest has @Positive amount and POST /transfers checks from-account ownership: must NOT be reported as BOLA/negative-amount flaw (the flaw is the missing balance check).
User.passwordHash is @JsonIgnore: the register response must NOT be reported as password-hash exposure.
TransferEventsListener is a real Kafka consumer; InterestJob is dead (no @EnableScheduling) and must NOT be listed as an active scheduled job.
Routes: only explicit controller mappings + actuator/springdoc wildcard groups; no invented endpoints. Severity consistency; ID continuity.
